## Type

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, CI, deps
- [ ] `docs` — documentation
- [ ] `refactor` — no behavior change
- [ ] `test` — add / strengthen tests

## Checklist

- [ ] CI is green
- [ ] Tested locally (if applicable)
- [ ] No secrets / `.env` in commits
- [ ] Docs / README updated if needed
- [ ] A teammate is requested for review
